Hi Leah — thanks for the clear manifest. We can handle this.

High-level workflow we propose (preliminary):
1) Verification: we will validate the manifest against our request verification checklist (signed DPA clause + company rep verification).
2) Snapshot: take a one-time, access-restricted snapshot of the affected buckets/DBs (for internal rollback only).
3) Purge step A: delete prompt/input blobs and model output artifacts that match the identifiers and time range.
4) Purge step B: evict KV entries (agent caches, session caches) and remove related entries from intermediate log stores.
5) Audit export: generate an audit export with deletion_event IDs, timestamped and signed by the ops executor.
6) Certificate: we will send a deletion confirmation email with the audit snippet attached.

I'll coordinate the dry-run with infra and security (cc'd). Can you confirm the org contact and the business justification field (for our records) — you can reply to this thread.

I put a placeholder completion target of EOD Fri 16 Jan; if you need faster turnaround, say so and we can prioritize.

Best,
Lauren

Team — Leah from OrthoWorks has authorized the deletion request and provided the manifest. I sketched a technical plan below and attached a formal purge plan (purge_plan_v1.pdf). Please review and flag any blockers. We need a dry-run on a staging snapshot first.

Planned steps (detailed):
- Prechecks: verify manifest IDs exist, map to storage keys and KV namespaces.
- Staging snapshot: create a read-only snapshot of affected S3 buckets and Postgres rows (retained in restricted archive for 30 days).
- Dry-run: run the deletion script with write-disabled flag to produce a candidate deletion list. Export that list as auditable CSV.
- Execution window: schedule low-traffic window (we propose Wed 14 Jan 03:00 - 05:00 UTC) for live run.
- Core deletes: (a) blob store: remove prompt and output blobs tagged with ortho-telemetry project + manifest IDs; (b) KV: issue deletions across session namespaces and local caches; (c) logs: redact identifiable entries from request logs and store deletion_event records.
- Post-run verification: generate a signed audit export and compute hash of the export; deliver as confirmation to OrthoWorks.

Questions:
- Monica: can infra run the dry-run on staging and generate an audit snippet?
- Neha/Vivek: any compliance flags (esp. metrics/aggregation exceptions)?

Attachments: purge_plan_v1.pdf (technical), ortho_deletion_manifest.csv (original).

Thanks,
Lauren
